<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1204
Claimant:
Ashley Butler
Adjuster:
Jerry Hanson
April 8, 2025
Claimant reported a low-speed collision while backing out of a space in a parking lot and said the other vehicle struck
the rear quarter panel of their car. Claimant is not represented by an attorney and provided initial contact details
voluntarily.
May 31, 2025
Reviewed the police report and confirmed the claimant was in the vehicle at the time of the incident, as the
responding officer and two witnesses described the same sequence of events.
June 8, 2025
Obtained photos from the scene and from the other driver showing contact damage consistent with the described
impact. The damage to the rear quarter panel and bumper is mostly in line with a collision of this type.
June 25, 2025
Spoke with the other driver, who confirmed the accident happened as the claimant described it and that the vehicles
made contact in the lot.
June 28, 2025
Claimant reports pain in the right shoulder following the impact and has started seeing a physician. The reported
injury is plausible for a collision of this kind.
July 31, 2025
Checked prior claims and vehicle history. No earlier damage to this vehicle is known, and nothing suggests the
damage predates the start of the current coverage period.
August 9, 2025
Confirmed no earlier injury to the same shoulder area is on file. Claimant described no prior treatment for that body
part.
August 16, 2025
Claimant told the same account of the incident in each conversation so far, including the location, the direction of
travel, and the sequence of contact.
September 12, 2025
Received treatment records showing the claimant attended physical therapy on a usual schedule. Symptoms have
improved steadily, and the treatment plan is tapering off as recovery progresses.
September 18, 2025
Confirmed the driver of the vehicle lievs with the policyholder and qualifies as a covered household member under
the policy.
September 21, 2025
Reviewed the medical notes with the claimant's permission. Progress is consistent with the expected recovery course
for this type of soft tissue shoulder injury, and no complications have been recorded.
October 20, 2025
Claim is progressing normally. Remaining items are the final medical bill and the repair estimate. Will follow up once
both are received.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
